ytterbite.m: A mineral that is a source of rare earths; consists of silicates of iron and beryllium and cerium and yttrium and erbium.

ytterbium.m: A soft silvery metallic element; a rare earth of the lanthanide series; it occurs in gadolinite and monazite and xenotime.

yttrium.m: A silvery metallic element that is common in rare-earth minerals; used in magnesium and aluminum alloys.
